luchik.why: The moon rises over a dark forest, the wind stops, and the moonbeam says goodnight to every animal.
luchik.description: A moonbeam puts the forest to sleep, one animal at a time. Night.
luchik.shows: A moonbeam bunny visits each animal in turn, leaves a light with a frightened bear cub and counts nuts with a worried squirrel until every one sleeps.

odeyalo.why: A cold autumn night. The bear pulls his blanket up and the moon hides, so the last line is darkness.
odeyalo.description: A bear finds his blanket and the moon hides. Night.
odeyalo.shows: A bear lets every cold animal under his blanket, saying there is room for all, and the guests shift to make space.

palchiki.why: A quiet evening, the first star, and a fox cub who does not want to sleep until his fingers count him down.
palchiki.description: A fox cub counts his fingers down to sleep. Night.
palchiki.shows: A mother fox helps her cub put each part of his body to sleep, stroking, tucking and kissing him until he rests.

poezd.why: The train only runs at night, takes the ones who want to sleep, and never hurries or wakes anyone.
poezd.description: A quiet night train takes the sleepy ones home. Night.
poezd.shows: A night train picks up tired animals, waits for the slow ones and thanks the owl who guards the forest.

solnce.why: Before dawn the mouse wakes the field: the rooster crows, the mist lifts, the sun comes up and everyone gets breakfast.
solnce.description: A mouse wakes the field and the sun comes up. Morning.
solnce.shows: A mouse asks his neighbours for help, they all call out until the sun rises, and the squirrel brings him breakfast in thanks.

tramvay.why: Before dawn a tram rolls out: the bakery opens, the market sets up and the sun comes over the roofs.
tramvay.description: A tram rolls out before dawn and the city wakes around it. Morning.
tramvay.shows: A tram and its driver carry a baker, a flower seller, a grandmother and a schoolgirl to work, give way to a cyclist and thank one another.

petuh.why: A rooster sleeps through the dawn, a sparrow wakes him and the whole yard sings the sun up.
petuh.description: A rooster sleeps through the dawn and a sparrow wakes him. Morning.
petuh.shows: A sparrow wakes a rooster who overslept and helps him warm up his voice, and the rooster thanks him and they agree to help each other.

hleb.why: The baker heats the oven before dawn, the street wakes to the smell, and a boy carries warm bread home to breakfast.
hleb.description: A baker heats the oven before dawn and a boy carries warm bread home. Morning.
hleb.shows: A boy waits for the bread to cool, carries it home to his grandmother and sees how much work is in a loaf.

utka.why: At first light a duck walks her seven ducklings to the pond, teaches them to swim and dries them on a warm stone.
utka.description: A duck walks her seven ducklings to the pond at first light. Morning.
utka.shows: A mother duck leads her seven ducklings to the pond at first light, teaches them to swim and find food and greets the heron and the swan politely.

strah.why: A hare cub in a dark burrow is afraid of a noise, and finds two animals more afraid than he is.
strah.description: A hare cub hears a noise and finds friends in the dark. Night.
strah.shows: A frightened hare cub takes his torch, opens the door to the noise and invites two more frightened animals in.

dozhd.why: A duckling runs out into warm rain, dances in a puddle and laughs with his mother.
dozhd.description: A duckling dances in the warm rain and laughs. Morning.
dozhd.shows: A duckling splashes in a warm puddle and laughs, and his mother dances with him and praises his song.

sharik.why: A balloon leaves the bear cub's paw. He cries, his mother sits with him, and the tears dry.
sharik.description: A bear cub loses his balloon and his mother sits with him. Night.
sharik.shows: A mother bear sits with her cub after his balloon flies away and lets him cry until he feels better.

zlost.why: The block tower falls and the fox cub is angry. He stamps, then breathes out and builds again.
zlost.description: A fox cub gets angry, breathes out and builds again. Morning.
zlost.shows: A fox cub stamps when his tower falls, then breathes out with his mother and builds it again.

chto-eto.why: A squirrel finds a round piece of glass in the grass. Something looks back at him. It is himself.
chto-eto.description: A squirrel finds a little mirror and a friend looks back. Morning.
chto-eto.shows: A squirrel cub finds a small round mirror, sees his own face and carries it to his mother so that they look together.

kotenok.why: The evening comes down, the mother purrs, the rain gets quieter and the kitten sleeps.
kotenok.description: A kitten falls asleep while his mother purrs and the rain stops. Night.
kotenok.shows: A mother cat lies beside her kitten and purrs while he breathes slowly and falls asleep.

lodochka.why: A wooden boat carries a sleepy mouse down a quiet night river. At every bend one animal settles for the night and gets quieter, until the lantern goes out at his mother's bank.
lodochka.description: A little boat carries a sleepy mouse home past animals going to sleep. Night.
lodochka.shows: A wooden boat carries a sleepy mouse down the river past animals settling for the night, and his mother lifts him home to sleep.

moloko.why: An evening in a warm flat with the moon, pyjamas, a blanket and a boy falling asleep.
moloko.description: Vanya spills his milk, tells Grandpa first, and they wipe it up. Night.
moloko.shows: Vanya puts the cup down, walks to the kitchen and tells his grandfather that he spilled the milk before anyone asks.

prosti.why: Dusk in the forest, the stars come out and two friends fall asleep in a moss house.
prosti.description: Topa steps on Ryzhik's twig house, says sorry, and they build it again. Night.
prosti.shows: Topa stays beside the broken house, says sorry to Ryzhik, and Ryzhik forgives him and asks him to mend it together.

spasibo.why: Sunset, the moon rises and the hares yawn and go to sleep in their burrow.
spasibo.description: Papa Hare, Pryg and Skok thank the day one gift at a time. Night.
spasibo.shows: At sunset the hares name each good thing of the day and say thank you for it, and the little hares thank their father for carrying them over the stream.

koridor.why: The story opens at night under the moon and stars and ends with the girl falling asleep in bed.
koridor.description: Nina walks the dark hall with Grandma, then back on her own. Night.
koridor.shows: Nina says the dark hall scares her a little, walks it holding Grandma's hand, then walks back alone while Grandma watches from the kitchen door.

sad.why: The story takes place on an evening under the first star and the moon and ends with the boy falling asleep.
sad.description: Lyova and Mama water the sprouts and tuck the garden in. Night.
sad.shows: Lyova lifts a beetle off the path on a leaf and carries it to the grass, then covers the smallest sprout with an upside-down flowerpot for the night.

ulitka.why: The story takes place on an evening while the moon rises and ends with the snail and the beetle asleep.
ulitka.description: Ula the snail slips, tries again, and Tuk waits for her. Night.
ulitka.shows: Ula slips off a wet leaf three times and climbs it again each time, while her friend Tuk sits down, hums and waits for her instead of rushing ahead.

lopatka.why: The opening has the early morning sun, dew on the swing, the yard waking and a new day.
lopatka.description: Two friends, one red spade and a sand castle in the sun. Morning.
lopatka.shows: Katya lets go of the one spade and counts to five aloud while Dima digs, and then they swap.

korzinka.why: The opening has the morning, the dawn, dew on the grass, the sun over the willow and a new day.
korzinka.description: A duckling and a rabbit help a badger push his apple cart uphill. Morning.
korzinka.shows: Nobody asks the duckling Pukh, yet he walks behind the badger's stuck cart and pushes it uphill.

sapozhok.why: The opening has a sunny morning, the sun in the window, a child who woke up, breakfast and a new day.
sapozhok.description: Asya pulls on her red boots by herself on the third try. Morning.
sapozhok.shows: Asya takes off the boot that did not fit and tries again, twice, while her father waits and does not do it for her.

mozhno.why: The opening has first sun, dew on the meadow and a fox cub who wakes up for the day.
mozhno.description: A fox cub asks a hedgehog before he strokes him. Morning.
mozhno.shows: The fox cub stops his paw, asks the hedgehog if he may stroke him, waits when the hedgehog says not yet, and then strokes the prickles softly downward.

yagoda.why: The opening has first sun over the berry glade, dew on the grass and berries picked for breakfast.
yagoda.description: A bear cub eats the last berry and tells his papa first. Morning.
yagoda.shows: The bear cub leaves the leaf that could wipe his red mouth and tells his father that he ate the last berry before his father asks.

zaika.why: The opening has the rain ending, the sun coming out, dew in the yard and a girl who is fully awake.
zaika.description: A brother says sorry and his sister helps wash the wet toy hare. Morning.
zaika.shows: The little brother says sorry after his stick knocks the toy hare into the puddle, and his sister forgives him and washes the hare with him.
